editorial.name: Weav
editorial.descriptionZh: Weav 是用自家文档训练的 AI 客服，把官网和帮助文档喂进去后自己答掉七成问题。首页一整屏宝蓝，右侧用一只举着手机的手演一段真实对话。
editorial.takeawayZh: 把一段客服对话放进手机屏，直接演给你看
editorial.noteZh: 整屏宝蓝底，底边压着一排粉色波浪齿，导航只有 Product / Pricing / Blog 与 Sign In、粉底 Get started。左半边先用一行小字 AI customer service solutions 起头，再压大标题 You didn't start a business to answer support emails all day.，副标把能力说成 Weav learns your business from your website and docs, then resolves over 70% of customer questions on its own. Day and night, in your voice. Set it up free in minutes.，按钮是白底 Get started free → 与半透明 Book a demo。右半边是一只真人手举着 iPhone，屏幕里是 weav.com 的聊天窗口，对话按顺序演：Weav 先问 Hey! How can I help you today?，顾客 Anna 说优惠码下错了单，Weav 回 Hi Anna! Let's fix that for you. I've located your order #190326 and applied the $60 coupon. That's all sorted for you, thanks!，底下标 Powered by Weav。正文把产品分成 AI agents / Inbox / Chatbots / Ask Weav / Training / Reporting 几块，并有一节叫 Train weav once. Watch it improve forever.。
editorial.pricing: unknown（首页只写 Get started free 与 Set it up free in minutes.，档位见 /pricing）

reasons.statement: 首屏交付的是 Weav 自己的对话演示、能力说明与试用入口，用户拿走的是整屏宝蓝加手机对话截图这一套排版；来自 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感池，故归产品与公司官网。
导航为 Product / Pricing / Blog 加 Sign In、Get started，另有 /comparison 与 /blog/gorgias-alternatives 等对比内容，主线是产品门面。
